observations.why: Directive with operational cadence language ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects others to follow — decision-grade ratification without hedging.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic, identity-level formulation cast as constitutive bedrock — equates rehearsal with possession itself, creed-like permanence language with no hedging.
